mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns remain positive or unchanged in periods of CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals economic distress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns remain positive or unchanged in periods of UNRATE rising > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 5% month-over-month indicates weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns remain positive or unchanged in periods of RSAFS dropping > 5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns remain negative or unchanged in periods of INDPRO rising > 2% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns remain negative or unchanged in periods of FEDFUNDS < 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3% within a month signals improving labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns remain negative or unchanged in periods of UNRATE dropping > 0.3% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% month-over-month indicates strengthening demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns remain negative or unchanged in periods of HOUST rising > 10% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) and a decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns remain positive or unchanged in periods of rising UNRATE and dropping PAYEMS.
